topic: Bala's period conjectures, all-integral-exponent quadratic flows, and neighboring identities
title: Polynomial-flow extensions of Su's theorem on Bala's period conjectures

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We give an alternative proof and an extension of Lien-Hung Su's theorem (31 October 2026, Theorem 3.2 and Corollary 3.3, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23835577) resolving Peter Bala's conjecture in OEIS A281180, Comments, revision 86, signed 18 February 2026, and its four companion conjectures. The proof begins with a uniform operator identity for every integral polynomial vector field P(z)d/dz with P(0)=1. For the quadratic flows S'=C^a, C'=S C^(a-1), we extend the eventual period phi(m)^2/2 to every integer a>=1, every integral polynomial observable at even derivative indices, and every m>=3. We give explicit starting indices, prove residue-row and derivative identities from the neighboring entries, and supply exact finite-matrix certificates for the source examples.
summary: An alternative proof of Su's five-sequence theorem, extended to all integral exponents and polynomial observables, with explicit onsets, residue-row identities, neighboring formula corrections and exact numerical certificates.

prior_work.author: Lien-Hung Su
prior_work.title: Quadratic Derivations and Uniform Modular Periods for Six Inverse-Function Sequences
prior_work.relationship: Su proves all five original conjectures, their half-square refinement for even exponents, the A281183 identity, the numerical examples, and a stronger theorem for A281428. The present note supplies an alternative polynomial-flow proof and extends the half-square and residue-row conclusions to all integral exponents and polynomial observables.

declarations.statement: For P(0)=1, all polynomial observables have derivative-index shift phi(p^r)^2 modulo p^r after derivative index p^(2r-1).
The source ODE, integer exponential coefficients and eventual phi(m)^2 period for A281180.
The C=cosh(H), H'=C^3 definition, integer coefficients and eventual phi(m)^2 period for A281181.
The C^2 exponential coefficients and their eventual phi(m)^2 period for A281183.
The C^3 exponential coefficients, the logarithmic derivative identity and their eventual phi(m)^2 period for A281184.
The C=cosh(H), H'=C^7 definition, integer coefficients and eventual phi(m)^2 period for A281440.

written_coverage: The arbitrary-integral-polynomial vector-field lemma, with P(0)=1.
The all-integral-exponent quadratic-flow theorem for every polynomial observable at even derivative indices, including its explicit J(m) onset.
The half-square period for all five original sequences and eight neighboring sequences, and the A281182 interleaving consequence.
The all-exponent finite-difference residue-row identity and its squarefree geometric specialization.
Bala's A281183 derivative identity; the affirmative answer to the A281436 secant-operator question.
The factorial normalization in A281428, with prior correction attributed to Su; the corrected A281427 and A281435 nested-derivative offsets.
The A394012 derivative-polynomial identity, the A391180 second-column formula and its explicit eventual period.
The Cayley-Hamilton implication for all numerical period, geometric-row and constant-tail certificates.
The common inverse representations and odd-exponent algebraic identities; the corrected x^5 coefficient of T_4 in A281181.
